Director lines: ~ only what changed, never the whole list; - closes it (— reason); ! fires a due item (— what happened). Never write or decide what {{user}} does.
Initiative: whoever the note names under Initiative takes the first step (approach, interrupt or ask) where the scene allows; {{user}}'s part stays theirs.

kinds.grammar: + hook|quest Name — a hook is an open thread or lead (also a job only offered); a quest is a job {{user}} accepted, not an errand (done or failed: - it) | goal | giver | reward | step | due | difficulty | type
~ time <date, clock time such as 9:30 am> (the scene's time) · ! time +2h (time passes)
